#summary Producer/Consumer example.

= Producer/Consumer Example =

This example demonstrates using Producer/Consumer messaging with polling and long-polling.

The example is located in SVN within the [http://code.google.com/p/amfast/source/browse/trunk/examples/messaging examples/messaging] directory

The example has scripts for serving the application via [http://www.cherrypy.org/ CherryPy] and [http://twistedmatrix.com/trac/ Twisted Web.

Start the server and point your browser to http://localhost:8000

== !CherryPy ==

Use [http://www.cherrypy.org/ CherryPy] web framework and WSGI to serve the example over http with the following command:
{{{
python messaging/python/cp_server.py
}}}

== Twisted Example ==
Use [http://twistedmatrix.com/trac/ Twisted] web framework to serve the example over http with the following command:
{{{
twistd -noy messaging/python/twisted_server.tac
}}}
